The lease liability and corresponding right-of-use asset primarily relate to its office space and data center operating leases. The prospective impact on the consolidated statement of operations under the new standard is substantially similar compared to the current lease accounting model. The Company's accounting for capital leases related to infrastructure equipment, now referred to as financing leases under the new standard, is substantially unchanged under the new standard.
